# Link Graph Tests — links show, backlinks, orphans commands

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Links Test Note
summary: A note for link testing
tags: linktest
---
This note links to [[another-note]] and references [[decisions/search-decision]].
-- note-input.md --

-- note2-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Another Links Note
summary: Second note for link testing
tags: linktest
---
This note links back to [[links-test-note]].
-- note2-input.md --

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Links Decision
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: Decision for link testing
tags: linktest
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-01-01'
---
We decided based on [[links-test-note]].
-- adr-input.md --

-- broken-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Broken Link Note
summary: Note with broken links
tags: linktest
---
This note has a [[nonexistent-page]] link.
-- broken-input.md --

-- wikilink-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Wikilink Format Note
summary: Note testing wikilink formats
tags: linktest
---
Simple link: [[another-links-note]]
Display link: [[another-links-note|alt display]]
Heading link: [[another-links-note#Introduction]]
Heading with display: [[another-links-note#Introduction|see intro]]
-- wikilink-input.md --

# --- Setup: initialize KB and write pages ---

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

exec akb write links-test-note.md <../note-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/links-test-note.md'

exec akb write another-links-note.md <../note2-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/another-links-note.md'

exec akb write links-decision.md <../adr-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/links-decision.md'

exec akb write broken-note.md <../broken-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/broken-note.md'

# --- links show displays outbound links ---

exec akb links notes/links-test-note.md
stdout 'Outbound:'
stdout 'another-note'
stdout 'search-decision'

# --- links show displays broken links ---

exec akb links notes/broken-note.md
stdout 'Broken:'
stdout 'nonexistent-page'

# --- links show with nonexistent page returns error ---

! exec akb links notes/no-such-page.md
stderr 'page not found'

# --- backlinks shows inbound links ---

exec akb backlinks notes/links-test-note.md
stdout 'notes/another-links-note.md'
stdout 'decisions/links-decision.md'

# --- backlinks with nonexistent page returns error ---

! exec akb backlinks notes/no-such-page.md
stderr 'page not found'

# --- orphans shows pages with zero inbound links ---

exec akb orphans
stdout 'notes/broken-note.md'

# --- orphans on empty KB returns no output ---

exec akb delete notes/links-test-note.md
exec akb delete notes/another-links-note.md
exec akb delete decisions/links-decision.md
exec akb delete notes/broken-note.md

exec akb orphans
! stdout .

# --- Missing search.db produces rebuild hint for links ---

exec rm .akb/search.db

! exec akb links notes/links-test-note.md
stderr 'akb index rebuild'

! exec akb backlinks notes/links-test-note.md
stderr 'akb index rebuild'

! exec akb orphans
stderr 'akb index rebuild'

# --- Wikilink format variants ---

exec akb index rebuild
stdout 'Index rebuilt'

exec akb write wikilink-note.md <../wikilink-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/wikilink-note.md'

# links show resolves various wikilink formats
exec akb links notes/wikilink-note.md
stdout 'Outbound:'
stdout 'another-links-note'
